chunks: When Our clear revelations are read out to them, they say: "This is only a man who wants to turn you away from what your fathers used to worship." And they say: "This is nothing but a fabricated lie." And those who do not believe say of the truth when it has reached them: "This is nothing but pure sorcery."
ai.seo_question: How did the disbelievers react when the Quran was recited to them?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the psychological resistance of the Quraysh, who dismissed the Quranic revelation not on theological grounds but as a threat to their ancestral traditions and social status. In Shia exegesis, this is often linked to the concept of *Ta'wil* (interpretation), where the elite misinterpreted the clear signs (*Ayat Bayyinat*) to maintain their power, a theme echoed in the Ahl al-Bayt's struggle against Umayyad authority.
